founderAnswers.topic: Schedule and caps for the native units (D2)
founderAnswers.terms: Window 2026-11-09T20:30Z to 2026-11-30; cohort of at most 4 serial units; D2 caps unchanged (30 min per unit, session at most 10 % of 5-hour, cohort at most 15 % of weekly, weekly stop above 80 %, EUR 0, subscription route); more than 4 units needs a new founder decision; operator types usage readings at most 5 minutes old before and after each unit.

readingAtDecision.note: weekly above 80 %: no unit can start before the weekly reset

founderAnswers.terms: Refresh authority_snapshot and evidence_snapshot to a recent public develop commit in the T008 change, keeping them historical, with old and new hashes recorded.

Keep PR review and add an automatic guard: the lab driver refuses a unit when any of harness_manifest.py, harness_context.py, harness_observation.py, system_one.py differs from the sha256 it had at the qualified commit 320b00c4, unless the founder approved that exact hash.

founderAnswers.answer: A: tras T008 y T004, o 12-06 (Recommended)
founderAnswers.terms: Keep the lab until SPEC-048/T008 and SPEC-049/T004 are closed or 2026-12-06, whichever comes first; the orchestrator prepares a one-command teardown script that only the founder runs.
